shots.content_purpose: Show the video_2 woman singing the referenced performance at the café table, from setting down the cup through the sustained final note, while the video_1 Hitchcock camera movement runs continuously and keeps her scale fixed as the background recedes.
shots.description: <Subject 1> sits at the wicker table of <Video 2>, holding the small white ceramic cup in her right hand and looking down into it, with defocused patrons and a passer-by behind her. She lowers the cup onto the tabletop, where it settles with a soft clink, and her head comes up from the downward gaze as her mouth opens and she begins to sing on screen: <Subject 1> (S1) sings with the timbre and delivery referenced from <Audio 1>, <d>[English] Hold the light a little longer.</d> Her freed right hand extends forward with an open palm and draws inward toward her chest while her head tilts back, following the phrasing of <Subject 2>. Throughout the take the camera pushes in toward her at a slow, steady rate with large amplitude while zooming out by a matching amount, so her face and shoulders keep the same size in frame while the blurred café background widens and recedes behind her. Still singing without a break, <Subject 1> (S1) raises her right hand to her face, her fingers brushing her cheek and the curls beside her ear, and her head tilts to the side, continuing, <d>[English] Keep it here with me.</d> She then lowers the hand from her face and extends it outward again with an open palm as her head tilts further back, and the phrase resolves on a sustained open note that carries to the final frame. The push ends with the background at its widest and most distant, and the shot closes on her sustained note, right arm extended, the small cup resting on the table in front of her.
